access_token.description: Password to use for connecting to the server. Can be designated by the `MASTODON_ACCESS_TOKEN` environment variable.

client_id.description: Client ID for Mastodon App. Can be designated by the `MASTODON_CLIENT_ID` environment variable.

client_secret.description: Client Secret for Mastodon App. Can be designated by the `MASTODON_CLIENT_SECRET` environment variable.

email.description: Username to connect to the server as. Can be designated by the `MASTODON_USER_EMAIL` environment variable.

host.description: Mastodon host to connect to. Can be designated by the `MASTODON_HOST` environment variable.

password.description: Password to use for connecting to the server. Can be designated by the `MASTODON_USER_PASSWORD` environment variable.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the post was created.

preserve_on_destroy.description: When destroyed, preserve the post on the server.

sensitive.description: Whether the post contains sensitive content.

visibility.description: The post visibility: can be `public`, `unlisted`, `private`, or `direct`.

block.description: This resource is used to manage posts on a Mastodon instance.

bot.description: Whether the account is a bot or not.

id.description: A unique account identifier retrieved from the server.

locked.description: Whether the account is locked or not.

note.description: The note or biography of the account.

username.description: The username of the account to lookup. This should include the domain.

block.description: This data source can be used to look up accounts in the Fediverse.

identity.description: Returns the identity string of a user from a specific server.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username to generate the identity from.

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: The server the user is hosted on.
